blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro has asked whether Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers failed to consult a former law school dean before asking for a subpoena to present him as a witness for the impeachment trial. Luistro posed the question as the academician begged off. She said on Thursday that she is surprised to hear that former University of St. La Salle (USLS) law school dean Ralph Sarmiento declined to testify as a defense witness for Duterte’s impeachment.
